title: Vandalism
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, Pam discovers her mural has been vandalized, prompting a meeting where characters discuss the incident and potential responses. Pam seeks support from Nellie and Dwight, while tensions arise as she considers targeting Nate. The episode also features character interactions at a party, including Pam's act of revenge on Frank and humorous exchanges among the staff. The episode explores themes of vandalism, support, and character relationships without resolving the vandalism case.
